parsed.explanation: The write-up explicitly leaves stabilization/finiteness as the “remaining crux” and supports it only numerically. None of Lemmas A–D proves large-prime erasure or any equivalent finite-prime dependence for all terms. The objection overstates matters by saying “nothing is established,” since the stated Theorem A supplies the characterization/reduction L6.1; nevertheless, its decisive local point is correct: L6.2 is missing, so the proposed periodicity assembly cannot be completed.
